desc: Whether you are hunting, hiking, checking your perimeter or just observing wildlife, the Axion XM30F is the optic of choice. It fits conveniently into a pocket or bag and can be ready-to-work at a moment's notice. The Axion XM30F can help you make the crucial distinction between a human, wild animal, family pet or livestock. It has a built-in stadiametric rangefinder, so you always know the distance to your target, and its durable housing and IPX7 waterproof-rating mean the Axion XM30F can be used in a wide variety of weather conditions. Possessing 3-12x digital magnification, the Axion XM30F records .mp4 videos and is compatible with the Stream Vision 2 App, so users can capture and preserve precious outdoor memories. The Axion XM30F takes Li-Ion 18650 batteries and boasts 5 hours of battery life, and is rechargeable by an external, 5-volt Micro USB. It is rated IPX7 fully-waterproof and weighs a mere .55lbs.
